system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: DB-backed wakeup queue with coalescing, budget checks, workspace resolution, secret injection, skill loading, and adapter invocation.
system_prompt_style.note: Paperclip is an orchestrator; agents bring their own prompts ('Agents bring their own prompts, models, and runtimes'). Runtime skill injection and goal ancestry context suggest composition; no prompt-assembly code in evidence.

env_context_strategy.note: Context strategy is delegated to external agents (Claude Code, Codex); no instance template or tool list in evidence.

context_compaction.note: No history-processing code in evidence; handled by adapted agents.

tool_call_format.note: Tool-call parsing is inside third-party agents; not in evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: README mentions MCP Tool Gateway but schema-producing code not in evidence.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: MCP Tool Gateway & Apps (governed tool access)
protocol_standardization.note: other = ACP (Agent Client Protocol) per doc/acp-run-lifecycle.md 'how one ACP agent run starts'.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: By default, agents run on scheduled heartbeats and event-based triggers (task assignment, @-mentions).
loop_primitives.note: Inner loop belongs to adapted agents; Paperclip drives them via heartbeat/event wakeups.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Deep Planning (planning mode, revisioned plans, plan approvals)

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Hierarchies, roles, reporting lines. Your agents have a boss, a title, and a job description.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Agents wake on a schedule, check work, and act. Delegation flows up and down the org chart.
delegation_mechanism.note: Delegation via shared issue/ticket system; closest value message_bus.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Board approval workflows, execution policies with review/approval stages, decision tracking, budget hard-stops, agent pause/resume/terminate, and full audit logging.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Issues carry company/project/goal/parent links, atomic checkout with execution locks, first-class blocker dependencies, comments, documents, attachments, work products, labels, and inbox state.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Skills Manager, Skill Studio & Skills Store
long_term_memory.note: Memory / Knowledge is on roadmap (not shipped).

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Agents resume the same task context across heartbeats instead of restarting from scratch.

self_verification.note: Review gates are human; harness-enforced checks not evidenced in code.

retry_policy.note: 'Self-healing runs & automatic recovery' mentioned without mechanism.

rollback.evidence_quote: isolated execution workspaces (git worktrees, operator branches)
rollback.note: Config-change rollback also mentioned ('bad changes can be rolled back safely').

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Monthly budgets per agent. When they hit the limit, they stop. No runaway costs.
termination_condition.note: Other termination handled by adapted agents; not in evidence.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Scoped budget policies with warning thresholds and hard stops. Overspend pauses agents and cancels queued work automatically.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Locally, a single Node.js process manages an embedded Postgres and local file storage.
execution_isolation.note: Sandbox backends (e2b, Cloudflare, Daytona, Modal, Kubernetes) reachable; default local adapters.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Paperclip does not resolve arbitrary machine-wide filesystem paths, absolute host paths, home paths, or relative paths that escape the selected workspace.
filesystem_access.note: Applies to workspace file links; agent process access not evidenced.

permission_model.evidence_quote: governance: who can do what · scoped secrets & company boundaries

tracing.evidence_quote: Paperclip ships with opt-in OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation for the server (traces only).
tracing.note: Structured run logs/activity on by default; OTel opt-in.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Sensitive values stay out of prompts unless a scoped run explicitly needs them.
guardrails.note: action_policies from approval gates/MCP governed tool access.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Paperclip is a Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of AI agents to run a business.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Cross-provider runtime: any model, any agent
